info.name: Funk & Disco
info.description: Funk grooves, slap bass and clavinet, disco strings and brass, a funk song.

songs.name: Funk Song
songs.description: A funk song in E minor: intro, verse, chorus, verse, chorus, break, chorus and outro, on the five Funk Song patterns, with automation: the clavinet's filter opens over the intro, the clap waits for the middle of the first chorus, the clavinet pans across the second verse, the snare throws an echo into each chorus, the bass goes under water for the break, and over the outro the bass fades out, the hats thin out and the brass rings into the reverb.

patterns.name: Disco Toms
patterns.description: Disco, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, 16th closed hats, open hat on each e, tom figure on 1-2 and a tom fill on 4, no snare; clap on 3& and 4 every 2 passes, crashes every 8.

patterns.name: Disco Upbeat
patterns.description: Disco, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on every & with 2a, clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on 1, e and a, open hat on each &; pitched toms on 3-4 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Disco
patterns.description: Disco, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on 2 and 4, closed hats on 1, e and a, open hat on each &; tom, clap and cowbell figures every 2 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Disco Strings and Brass
patterns.description: Disco, 4 measures: an ensemble of strings holding Am7, Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7, and brass stabs an octave up on 1, 1a, 2& and 3&.

patterns.name: Disco Groove
patterns.description: Disco groove, 2 measures: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on every & doubled to &-a at the end of measure 1, 16th hats, open hat on each &, clap on 1 and 3, syncopated cowbell, 16th toms through measure 2.

patterns.name: Funk
patterns.description: Funk, 1 measure: kick on 1, 3& and 4a every 4 passes, snare on 2, 2a, 3e and 4 with ghost fills on 4e-&-a, clap on every beat, 8th hats; crash on 4& every 6.

patterns.name: Funk Slap Bass
patterns.description: Funk with a slap bass, 1 measure: E minor pentatonic in 16ths, accented root on 1, octave pops on 1e and 3a, ghost notes at low velocity between, a run G A B on beat 4.

patterns.name: Funk Slow
patterns.description: Slow funk, 2 measures: syncopated kick with soft ghosts, snare on 4e, 6& and 8e, clap on 2, 3e, 3a, 4, 6, 7e and 8, broken 8th and 16th hats; snare fill on 8 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Funk Clav Riff
patterns.description: Funk Slow with a clavinet, 2 measures: staccato 16th stabs on E minor 7 for the first measure and A7 for the second, accents on 1 and 3, one ghost chord on 3.

patterns.name: Funk Fill
patterns.description: Funk fill, 1 measure: kick thickening from quarters to 16ths across the measure, snare on 2, 3, 4, 4& and 4a, quarter hats, toms on every &; 16th clap fill from 2& every 6 passes.

patterns.name: Funk Song Intro
patterns.description: Intro of the demo arrangement, 4 measures: a clavinet on E minor 7 over a kick and 8th hats, then the slap bass and 16th hats come in, and a snare and tom fill leads to the verse.

patterns.name: Funk Song Verse
patterns.description: Verse of the demo arrangement, 4 measures: E minor 7 for two measures, A7 for two; syncopated kick, backbeat with ghost notes, 16th hats, slap bass with octave pops, clavinet stabs, a fill on the last beat.

patterns.name: Funk Song Chorus
patterns.description: Chorus of the demo arrangement, 4 measures: C major 7, D, then E minor 7 for two; crash on the first downbeat, open hats on every &, clap on the backbeat, a driving bass, off-beat clavinet and brass stabs.

patterns.name: Funk Song Break
patterns.description: Break of the demo arrangement, 4 measures on E minor: kick, clap and the slap bass alone, the hats and the clavinet come back, and a snare build over the last measure leads to the chorus.

patterns.name: Funk Song Outro
patterns.description: Outro of the demo arrangement, 4 measures: the chorus on C major 7, D and E minor 7, then one last hit of the whole band on 1, left to ring.
